title: Enhancing Test-Time Scaling of Large Language Models with Hierarchical Retrieval-Augmented MCTS
authors_zh: Alex ZH Dou（凯斯西储大学）；Zhongwei Wan、Xin Wang、Mi Zhang（俄亥俄州立大学）；Dongfei Cui（杜克大学）；Jing Xiong、Chaofan Tao（香港大学）；Haokun Lin（香港城市大学）；Shen Yan（字节跳动）
paper_type_zh: 检索增强测试时搜索研究
best_for_zh: 比较数学推理中搜索时检索与过程验证方法的读者。
one_line: R2-LLMs uses coarse-to-fine retrieval inside PRM-guided MCTS so additional test-time compute explores reasoning paths with relevant external evidence.
R2-LLMs 将问题级与步骤级检索嵌入过程奖励模型引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索，使额外测试时计算能基于相关证据探索推理路径。
why: It makes retrieval an active component of the test-time compute allocation rather than a static prompt prefix.
inclusion_reason: It changes the test-time search budget by retrieving problem-level and step-level evidence inside PRM-guided MCTS, directly addressing how extra inference compute is allocated.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time tree search generates many candidate chains but evaluates them using only the model’s learned knowledge and a local process scorer. On difficult mathematics, that setup can repeatedly deepen an unpromising branch when the tree lacks a useful high-level strategy or an analogous intermediate step.

R2-LLMs asks how extra inference compute can consult external reasoning evidence without turning the system into a fixed retrieval prompt. It treats retrieval as part of the live search loop: the search should obtain an abstract solution pattern for the whole problem and relevant worked steps for the node currently being expanded.

多数测试时树搜索会生成许多候选推理链，却只依赖模型已学到的知识和局部过程评分器来评价它们。面对困难数学题，这种设置可能反复把搜索加深到没有希望的分支，因为搜索树既缺少有用的整体策略，也缺少与当前中间步骤相似的参考解法。

R2-LLMs 研究如何让额外推理计算查询外部证据，同时不把系统退化为固定的检索提示。它把检索纳入实时搜索循环：搜索既应为整道题取得抽象的解题模式，也应为当前待扩展节点取得相关的已解步骤。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central decision is to divide retrieval by the resolution at which search needs help. Deep Logical Retrieval first maps the input to an abstract conceptual template and supplies similar problem–answer examples, while a second retrieval stage finds analogous intermediate steps during tree expansion.

Those records do not replace the generator or the verifier. They alter the information available to both: retrieved templates inform candidate generation, retrieved steps give the process reward model more context for scoring, and MCTS spends its next expansions where the combined evidence is most favorable.

核心决定是按搜索需要帮助的粒度划分检索。深层逻辑检索先把输入映射为抽象概念模板，并提供相似的题目—答案示例；随后第二层检索在树扩展过程中寻找相似的中间推理步骤。

这些记录并不替代生成器或验证器，而是改变二者可获得的信息：检索到的模板指导候选生成，检索到的步骤让过程奖励模型评分时拥有更多上下文，蒙特卡洛树搜索则把后续扩展投入综合证据最有利的位置。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported pipeline extracts conceptual units with DeepSeek-70B, uses them to retrieve coarse reference examples, and then runs hierarchical augmented MCTS with a policy model. At fine resolution it retrieves analogous steps from mathematical reference data and lets a process reward model score the resulting node with that additional context.

The authors evaluate Llama-3.1-8B and Qwen2-7B on MATH500, GSM8K, and OlympiadBench-TO. The operative training consumer is not an offline finetuning loss: it is the test-time controller that repeatedly chooses retrieval, expansion, scoring, and back-propagation actions under an inference budget.

论文中的流程先利用 DeepSeek-70B 提取概念单元，以此检索粗粒度参考示例，再用策略模型运行分层增强的蒙特卡洛树搜索。在细粒度层面，它从数学参考数据中检索相似步骤，并让过程奖励模型结合这些额外上下文为节点评分。

作者在 MATH500、GSM8K 和 OlympiadBench-TO 上评估 Llama-3.1-8B 与 Qwen2-7B。实际消费这些信息的并不是离线微调损失，而是测试时控制器：它在推理预算内反复决定检索、扩展、评分和回传动作。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports that the retrieval-augmented system outperforms its ICL-based and tree-search baselines on all three mathematical benchmarks. Its headline claim is up to a 16% relative improvement for Llama-3.1-8B, which is evidence that additional calls can be made more useful by conditioning search on retrieved structures rather than merely increasing rollout count.

That evidence is bounded by the chosen retrieval corpora, process reward model, and benchmark domain. It demonstrates a concrete search-time allocation mechanism, not a general guarantee that external retrieval will improve every reasoning task or that its retrieved examples are contamination-free.

论文报告，该检索增强系统在三个数学基准上均超过基于上下文学习和树搜索的对照方法。其主要结果是 Llama-3.1-8B 最多获得 16% 的相对提升，说明比起单纯增加采样次数，让搜索依据检索到的结构进行条件化可以使额外调用更有价值。

这项证据受所选检索语料、过程奖励模型和基准领域限制。它证明的是一种具体的搜索时资源分配机制，并不保证外部检索会改善每一种推理任务，也不保证检索到的示例完全不存在污染风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The paper’s novelty is not MCTS or retrieval in isolation. Its distinctive move is to make retrieval operate at two different decision points in a test-time search: before search, it supplies a problem-level strategy; within search, it supplies step-level precedents for evaluating an evolving trajectory.

This makes the retriever, the generator, and the process reward model jointly determine how inference compute is spent. Compared with a static few-shot prompt, the reference record changes as the tree changes; compared with a plain PRM-guided tree, the score is informed by retrieved reasoning evidence rather than only the local text.

论文的新意不在于单独提出蒙特卡洛树搜索或检索。它的独特做法是让检索在测试时搜索的两个不同决策点发挥作用：搜索前提供题目级策略，搜索中为正在演化的轨迹评价提供步骤级先例。

这样一来，检索器、生成器和过程奖励模型共同决定推理计算如何花费。与静态少样本提示相比，参考记录会随着树的变化而变化；与普通的过程奖励模型引导树搜索相比，评分不再只依据局部文本，还依据检索到的推理证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: R2-LLMs adds latency and engineering dependencies for two retrieval stages, conceptual-unit extraction, a process reward model, and a tree-search controller. Retrieval quality can mislead search, reference data may be semantically close to evaluation items, and the reported evidence is concentrated on mathematical benchmarks; an implementation should therefore audit corpus provenance, retrieval failures, PRM calibration, and the marginal gain per additional call.
R2-LLMs 为两级检索、概念单元提取、过程奖励模型和树搜索控制器增加了延迟与工程依赖。检索质量不佳会误导搜索，参考数据可能与评测样本在语义上过近，且论文证据主要集中在数学基准；因此实现时应审计语料来源、检索失败、过程奖励模型校准，以及每增加一次调用带来的边际收益。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this work when a reasoning deployment can access a licensed reference corpus and a reliable process verifier, and when the test-time budget is large enough to justify selective retrieval during search. It is particularly useful as a comparison point for systems that must decide whether to buy one more rollout, inspect a partial chain, or retrieve evidence that may redirect the entire search tree.
当推理部署能够访问有合法授权的参考语料和可靠的过程验证器，且测试时预算足以支持在搜索中进行选择性检索时，可使用这项工作。它尤其适合作为比较基准：系统需要决定是多购买一次采样、检查一条部分推理链，还是检索可能改变整棵搜索树方向的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the retrieval construction and ablations before treating the reported gain as a pure search improvement. The key operational question is whether the coarse template and fine-grained step retrieval each improve a well-calibrated verifier under the same call budget; for reuse, record retrieval corpus versions, candidate overlap checks, PRM provenance, and total latency separately from answer accuracy.
在把论文报告的提升当作纯粹的搜索改进前，应先阅读检索构造和消融实验。关键运行问题是，在相同调用预算下，粗粒度模板检索与细粒度步骤检索是否都能改善已校准验证器；若要复用，应把检索语料版本、候选重叠检查、过程奖励模型来源和总延迟与答案准确率分别记录。
